desc:
⚠️ ALPHA: expect bugs. Found one? Report it in the picon studio community and we'll fix it.

🏀 OUTLAW BASKETBALL 🏀
3v3 streetball with slaps, bombs and punches. No refs, no fouls. 4-minute games, jump in solo, bots fill the rest.

Pros:
- Slap the ball out of their hands
- Bomb the whole lane
- Break ankles, dunk on people

Cons:
- Get slapped mid-jumper
- Get bombed the second you touch the ball

CONTROLS:
Shoot – Hold Left Click (early release = Pump Fake)
Pass / Steal – E
Block / Rebound – Space
Feint – Q
Item / Punch – F
Dash – Shift

Leave a 👍 and ⭐ if you got slapped and came back for more.
